# Oryx Institute

> Oryx Polytechnic Institute ("Oryx Institute") is a prelaunch polytechnic-style institute and consulting practice working from Windhoek, Namibia. Live today: crash courses and short courses in business administration and IT and related fields — the teaching offer, and all of it — beside business counselling, market research and development, Rapid Response Training, and the free Oryx Directory. The education (science, engineering, technology, applied problem-solving) is phased in as NQA/NTA accreditation progresses. One mailbox answers everything: info@oryxinstitute.org.

Oryx Institute states its status as it is: prelaunch, pre-accreditation, honest. It claims no campus, no public premises, no street address and no telephone line while none exist. Visits are arranged by appointment in Windhoek. Programme and course offerings are confirmed by the Principal's office at the point of application. The Principal is Tangi Iigonda.

## Courses and practice (live now)

- [Business counselling](https://oryxinstitute.org/apply): owner-level counselling for Namibian businesses at the moments that cost the most — starting, registering, hiring, pricing, pivoting or closing cleanly. Decisions, not decks.
- [Business administration](https://oryxinstitute.org/apply): a teaching department — crash and short courses in records, filings, registers and the everyday processes a business runs on. No long programmes are offered.
- [IT and related fields](https://oryxinstitute.org/apply): a teaching department — crash and short courses in the systems and software work runs on, from first principles to confident use. Every tool named, not magic.
- [Market research and development](https://oryxinstitute.org/research): feasibility studies, market sizing, competitor reads and route-to-market plans, gathered on Namibian ground and written to be used.
- [Rapid Response Training](https://oryxinstitute.org/faq): a business needs a team trained on something new — Oryx sources the industry expert, structures the programme, and delivers it.
- [The Oryx Directory](https://oryxinstitute.org/resources): free, Namibia-specific crash courses (four) and business templates (seven), copyrighted to Oryx Polytechnic Institute.

## Research & development

- [Research & Development](https://oryxinstitute.org/research): the R&D practice — market research for hire, and the institute's own builds.
- The AI training programme: built with [Tangison Technologies](https://tangison.com), announced 18 October 2026. The curriculum is being written module by module, and a flagship product is under construction on it. Schedule and syllabus are not final and are not printed.
- Skills Camp (Karibib VTC): the physical vocational training centre concept, in research and development on its own roadmap.
- The foundational course spine: AI, business, financial literacy, leadership and empathy as the mandatory spine — real once accreditation lands.

## Partners

- [Tangison Technologies](https://tangison.com): the AI training programme and the flagship product, built together.
- [Mendozer](https://mendozer.com): collaborating in concepts.
- Oryx remains open to partnerships with organizations pursuing similar goals: training bodies, accreditation partners, corporate sponsors, and complementary businesses. Enquiries: info@oryxinstitute.org.

## Education (phased, pre-accreditation)

- [The Schools](https://oryxinstitute.org/schools): School of Technology (open for enquiry), School of Engineering (coming soon), School of Science (coming soon).
- [Programmes & Disciplines](https://oryxinstitute.org/programmes): the four disciplines of a 理工 (science and engineering) education — science, engineering, technology, and applied problem-solving, the spine named on every certificate.
- Certificates: the institute issues its Certificate of Achievement on completion, recognizing "excellence in innovation and applied problem-solving", signed by the Principal and dated by hand. Oryx is not NQA/NTA accredited yet, and says so.
